title: Understanding Random Forests
text: Random forests are an ensemble method that uses multiple decision trees to make predictions. They can capture complex patterns by combining the outputs of individual trees.

title: Decision Boundaries in Random Forests
text: Random forests can create complex decision boundaries by aggregating the outputs of multiple decision trees. However, each individual tree in the forest creates axis-aligned splits.
